The '''Lowick asteroid belt''' was an [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid belt]] around [[Lowick/Legends|Lowick]] that [[firegem]] miners scouted in [[10 BBY/Legends|10 BBY]] before encountering the [[Pa'lowick/Legends|Pa'lowick]] species.
